reference_locator: Paragraph 29(a), absolute gross Scope 2 greenhouse gas emissions
rationale: Purchased-electricity activity, factor traceability, and a validated calculation may support preparation of Scope 2 greenhouse gas emissions information.
available_evidence: Normalized electricity use; registered factor; factor source; calculation formula; calculated emissions result.
missing_data: Full reporting-period completeness; full organizational coverage; reporting boundary reconciliation; methodology and assumption disclosure; materiality assessment; management review.
allowed_use: May be used as partial technical evidence for preparing Scope 2 greenhouse gas emissions information.
prohibited_use: Must not be presented as a complete annual IFRS S2 disclosure, a materiality conclusion, or an IFRS S2 compliance statement.

reference_locator: Paragraph 29(a), absolute gross Scope 1 greenhouse gas emissions
rationale: Controlled stationary natural-gas combustion is relevant to potential Scope 1 greenhouse gas emissions information, but the current calculation is blocked.
available_evidence: Natural-gas activity quantity; evidence source; organizational-boundary facts; Scope 1 stationary-combustion classification; registered gas-specific factors.
missing_data: Verified natural-gas heating value conversion; calculated emissions; complete reporting-period data; reporting boundary reconciliation; methodology and assumptions; materiality assessment.
allowed_use: May identify a Scope 1 evidence stream and a specific calculation dependency that must be resolved.
prohibited_use: Must not be reported as zero emissions or as a complete IFRS S2 Scope 1 disclosure.

reference_locator: Paragraph 29(a), absolute gross Scope 1 greenhouse gas emissions
rationale: Diesel used by a company-owned vehicle is relevant to potential Scope 1 greenhouse gas emissions information, but the current calculation is blocked.
available_evidence: Diesel activity quantity; evidence source; ownership and control facts; Scope 1 mobile-combustion classification; registered gas-specific factors.
missing_data: Verified diesel heating value conversion; calculated emissions; complete reporting-period data; reporting boundary reconciliation; methodology and assumptions; materiality assessment.
allowed_use: May identify a Scope 1 evidence stream and a specific calculation dependency that must be resolved.
prohibited_use: Must not be reported as zero emissions or as a complete IFRS S2 Scope 1 disclosure.

reference_locator: Paragraph 29(a) and paragraphs B38–B57, Scope 3 greenhouse gas emissions and measurement framework
rationale: Purchased steel is an upstream purchased-goods activity that may support Scope 3 Category 1 measurement, but the current record contains quantity evidence without an emissions calculation.
available_evidence: Purchased-material quantity; supplier document reference; Scope 3 Category 1 classification.
missing_data: Supplier-specific emissions or an appropriate documented estimation method; emission factor; data-quality assessment; methodology; inputs and assumptions; reporting-period coverage; materiality assessment.
allowed_use: May identify a Scope 3 Category 1 evidence stream and supplier-data request.
prohibited_use: Must not be presented as measured Scope 3 emissions or as proof that all relevant Scope 3 categories have been assessed.

reference_locator: Metrics and targets requirements and consideration of industry-based metrics
rationale: Finished-goods output may support an emissions-intensity denominator or another industry-based metric, but output quantity is not automatically a required IFRS S2 disclosure.
missing_data: Selected metric definition; industry-guidance applicability assessment; materiality assessment; allocation relationship; complete reporting-period coverage; management approval.
allowed_use: May support a future emissions-intensity or industry-based metric after the metric and allocation method are defined.
prohibited_use: Must not be treated as greenhouse gas emissions, negative emissions, or an automatically required IFRS S2 metric.
